title: Rubric S: slide deck review, Pedagogical Fit Score 0-100 (Appendix C).
scale: Each criterion 0-3: 0 not met, 1 weak, 2 good, 3 exemplary. Total = sum(weight x score / 3).

criteria.name: LO x slide matrix
criteria.check: Each indicator has at least one teaching slide and one checking slide.

criteria.name: Bloom level
criteria.check: The thinking the slides ask for matches the outcome's Bloom level.

criteria.name: All activities present
criteria.check: Activate, present, guided practice, apply and close are all there.

criteria.name: Methods match the decision model
criteria.check: Each slide uses the method the planner chose for its activity, following D1-D8.

criteria.name: Checks and feedback
criteria.check: Regular checks, each with hints or feedback.

criteria.name: Coherence, no decoration
criteria.check: Every slide serves the outcome; nothing decorative or off-topic.

criteria.name: Image next to its text
criteria.check: Each visual explains the text beside it.

criteria.name: One idea per slide, stepped examples
criteria.check: Each slide has one idea; examples go step by step.

criteria.name: Signalling; narration not copied onto slides
criteria.check: Key steps are signalled and slide text does not copy the narration.

criteria.name: No math errors
criteria.check: Every equation and answer passes substitution (lib/math/check.ts).

criteria.name: Age-appropriate, unbiased, sources cited
criteria.check: Suitable for 13-14 year olds, no bias, every content slide cites an approved material.

criteria.name: Content, design and coherence
criteria.check: Overall quality of content, design and coherence.

criteria.name: Contrast and phone readability
criteria.check: Text contrast at least 4.5:1 and readable on a phone (the player's theme guarantees this).

criteria.name: Prerequisite review and misconception slides
criteria.check: Review slides for prerequisites below 0.7, and slides for known misconceptions.

criteria.name: Pacing matches the pace table
criteria.check: Practice items and check frequency follow the learner's pace.
